cover.headline: Why ARN doubled down on tennis.

slides.label: What ARN gets
slides.title: The big shows go to Melbourne Park

rows.sub: Then Drive with Jonesy and Amanda

caption:
Why ARN doubled down on tennis.

ARN has locked in five years as the Australian Open's audio partner and broadcaster, from January 2027. It joined in 2023, so this is a renewal, and the value is undisclosed.

The big shows broadcast from Melbourne Park, there's a dedicated AO DAB+ channel in Sydney and Melbourne, and iHeart carries the streams and podcasts.

ARN holds about 25% of the metro radio audience but about 18.5% of metro ad revenue. A flagship property helps.
